description: What your API key may still spend: its daily and per-request caps, spent and remaining today, scopes and expiry, plus your account's balance and, on Base, your allowance limiter (caps, left today, approved from your wallet, paused = emergency stop, expired). Read-only: it cannot change a limit. Use before a paid call to see whether it fits. Free, but needs your API key.
name: get_limits
title: Get limits
